column1: # Shared $SHELL -> login-shell invocation cases. Three runtimes each decide how to start the user's
# login shell, and all three MUST agree on every row: Go internal/script's loginShellInvocation
# (host/environment/tests.rs). The code stays three copies, one per runtime (ADR 0005's spirit);
# this table is what keeps them one rule. A shell the rule doesn't know runs as a login /bin/sh.
# Format: <shell><TAB><program><TAB><flag>. A row with an empty shell (a line starting with a tab)
